This is a senior-level distributed systems engineering role on Cloudflare's Cache team, within the Content Delivery group that builds and runs the company's CDN. The work centers on the reverse proxy and caching data plane at Cloudflare's edge — cache storage and indexing, backend routing and load balancing, globally distributed purge, and Tiered Cache routing — along with customer-facing surfaces like Cache Rules, Cache Reserve, and the Workers Cache API. The core stack is Rust on Pingora, Cloudflare's open-source network services framework, with heavy emphasis on HTTP semantics, TCP/TLS/QUIC, Linux systems and networking, async I/O, concurrency, and production performance analysis.
